parts.title: Word List
parts.content:
Detailed Meanings

😎
attic[aetik]n.
An attic is a room just below a house’s roof.
→ There were two windows in their attic.
😎
chunk[tʃʌŋk]n.
A chunk is a thick, solid piece of something.
→ When they broke open the rock, they saw it was filled with chunks of gold.
😎
civic[sivik]adj.
If something is civic, then it is related to a town or city, especially its government.
→ Most of the important civic buildings are located downtown.
😎
descent[disent]n.
A descent is a movement downwards.
→ During the space shuttle’s descent, the Earth became larger and larger.
😎
din[din]n.
A din is loud, unpleasant, and extended noise.
→ The din of the rusty machinery made the factory a horrible place to work.
😎
dissatisfy[dissætisfai]v.
To dissatisfy someone means to fail to please them.
→ He was dissatisfied with his meal.
😎
fuss[fʌs]n.
A fuss is excited or annoyed behavior that is not useful in any way.
→ The child made an awful fuss because she didn’t want to go to bed.
😎
gourmet[guərmei]adj.
If food is gourmet, then it is nicer and more expensive than regular food.
→ In order to get a gourmet meal, you have to eat at an expensive restaurant.
😎
hence[hens]adv.
If something happens hence, then it happens as a result of something.
→ John forgot the key. Hence, we couldn’t open the door.
😎
intrinsic[intrinsik]adj.
If something is intrinsic, then it is related to the basic nature of that thing.
→ Paper money has no intrinsic value. It is useful simply because society says it is.
😎
kettle[ketl]n.
A kettle is a large metal pot used for boiling liquids or cooking food.
→ The soup was being cooked in a large kettle.
😎
ministry[ministri]n.
A ministry is a government department.
→ The Ministry of Trade is responsible for taxing imports and exports.
😎
ordeal[ɔ:rdi:əl]n.
An ordeal is a bad experience.
→ Driving in the snowstorm was an ordeal she’d never forget.
😎
outspoken[autspoukən]adj.
If someone is outspoken, then they are not afraid to say what they think.
→ She was an outspoken critic about the new banking laws.
😎
overwork[ouvərwə:rk]v.
To overwork someone means to make them tired with too much work.
→ After working for three weeks with only one day of rest, Judy was overworked.
😎
particular[pərtikjulər]adj.
If something is particular, then it is a single, important part of a group of things.
→ The dress shop didn’t have the particular dress she was looking for.
😎
pungent[pʌndʒənt]adj.
If something is pungent, then it tastes or smells strong and sharp.
→ The garlic made the soup taste so pungent that the chef wouldn’t serve it.
😎
snore[snɔ:r]v.
To snore means to make a loud noise each time a sleeping person breathes.
→ It was impossible to get to sleep because my husband snored.
😎
soundly[saundli]adv.
If something is done soundly, then it is done in the best or most complete way.
→ The nearest opponent was ten meters behind. She won the race soundly.
😎
superintendent[su:pərintendant]n.
A superintendent is a person who runs a certain department or building.
→ The superintendent decided to close the schools because of the weather.

sections.title: Exercise 1: Choose the one that is opposite in meaning to the given word.

questions.explanation: din (n): loud, unpleasant noise. Opposite is silence.
outspoken (adj): not afraid to say what they think. Opposite is quiet.
pungent (adj): tastes or smells strong and sharp. Opposite is mild.
civic (adj): related to a town or city. Opposite is private.
descent (n): movement downwards. Opposite is climb.
attic (n): a room just below a roof. Opposite is cellar (below ground).
fuss (n): excited or annoyed behavior. Opposite is calm.
dissatisfy (v): to fail to please someone. Opposite is please.
overwork (v): to make someone tired with too much work. Opposite is relax.
chunk (n): a thick, solid piece of something. Opposite is whole.

sections.title: Exercise 2: Choose the one that is similar in meaning to the given word.

questions.explanation: intrinsic (adj): related to the basic nature of a thing. Similar to natural.
ministry (n): a government department. Similar to agency.
snore (v): to make a loud noise while sleeping. Similar to grunt.
kettle (n): a large metal pot used for boiling. Similar to pot.
superintendent (n): a person who runs a department. Similar to manager.
gourmet (adj): nicer and more expensive food. Similar to delicious.
soundly (adv): in the most complete way. Similar to totally.
hence (adv): happens as a result. Similar to thus.
ordeal (n): a bad experience. Similar to problem.
particular (adj): a single, important part. Similar to exact.

sections.title: Exercise 3: Write a word that is similar in meaning to the underlined part.

questions.content:
The movement downward from the mountain was because it had started to rain. [ 21 ]

The berries were not ripe when he tried them. Their taste was extremely sharp and strong. [ 22 ]

A thick, solid piece of dirt was stuck underneath the wagon's tire. [ 23 ]

Please share your suggestions with the department leader so she can address them. [ 24 ]

After toiling for hours in the hot sun, the prisoners were tired from too much work. [ 25 ]

She was respected by many because she was not afraid to say what she thought. [ 28 ]

He always dreamed of getting a job with one of the departments of government. [ 29 ]

Getting lost in the desert would have been quite an awful experience. [ 30 ]

sections.title: Exercise 4: Write C if the italicized word is used correctly. Write I if the word is used incorrectly.

questions.content: The caffeine in the tea gave him more energy. Hence, he was more alert.
questions.explanation: Hence means it happens as a result of something.

questions.content: Mom, something smells good in the kitchen. I can't wait for din.
questions.explanation: Din means loud, unpleasant noise. The word meant here is probably dinner.

questions.content: The cat waited outside the door and made a fuss until someone let her inside the house.
questions.explanation: Fuss is excited or annoyed behavior.

questions.content: See that politician over there? He works in the Ministry of Truth.
questions.explanation: Ministry is a government department.

questions.content: The need to protect one's family is an intrinsic quality found in many animals.
questions.explanation: Intrinsic means related to the basic nature of something.

parts.title: Comprehensive Reading
parts.content:
The Butler's Bad Day

The superintendent of civic projects was a busy man. He worked every day of the week and had fancy parties at his house every night.

However, if there was someone busier than him, it was his butler. He worked all day organizing the superintendent's parties and then cleaned up after them late at night. Hence, while the superintendent slept soundly, snoring loudly in his bed, the butler was still awake.

Sadly, though the butler was always overworked, his profession's intrinsic nature demanded he never be outspoken. Therefore, his employer never knew the butler hadn't slept for several days. On any day the butler might make a mistake.

One day, the superintendent said, "This particular party is important. People from the ministry are coming. Everything must be perfect."

The butler began preparing at once. First he went to the attic to get more chairs and tables. But on his descent, he realized he needed to make the food. A gourmet dinner was necessary for such a party. He boiled water in a kettle for soup and chopped some beef into chunks. Just as he was starting the soup, he remembered that he had to sweep the veranda. As he was sweeping the veranda, he realized that he had to clean the sauna.

By this time, the first guests had arrived. The veranda was still dirty. There were not enough chairs for the guests to sit on, and the soup tasted too pungent. Some guests were dissatisfied. They started to make a fuss, and the party was filled with a din of complaints.

The superintendent's party was a disaster. He wondered why his butler had made so many mistakes. At last, the butler admitted to being exhausted. His boss felt pity for the butler. He had no idea the butler was so tired. He said, "You should have told me earlier, then we could have avoided this whole ordeal."

sections.title: Part A: Mark each statement T for true or F for false.

questions.content: The Superintendent of Civic Projects cleaned late at night; hence, he was busier than his butler.
questions.explanation: Câu này là False (Sai) . Đoạn 2 cho biết chính người quản gia (butler) mới là người dọn dẹp vào ban đêm: '...and then cleaned up after them late at night. Hence, while the superintendent slept soundly... the butler was still awake.' (...và sau đó dọn dẹp vào đêm khuya. Do đó, trong khi viên giám đốc ngủ say... thì người quản gia vẫn thức). Người quản gia bận rộn hơn viên giám đốc nhiều nhé!

questions.content: Though the butler was outspoken, his job's intrinsic nature made him never become overworked.
questions.explanation: Câu này là False (Sai) . Đoạn 3 có viết ngược lại hoàn toàn: 'Sadly, though the butler was always overworked, his profession's intrinsic nature demanded he never be outspoken.' (Đáng buồn thay, mặc dù người quản gia luôn làm việc quá sức, nhưng bản chất vốn có của nghề nghiệp lại đòi hỏi ông không bao giờ được thẳng thắn lên tiếng). Câu hỏi đã tráo đổi vị trí của 'outspoken' và 'overworked' đó!

questions.content: This particular party was important because people from the ministry were coming.
questions.explanation: Câu này là True (Đúng) nhé. Trong đoạn 4, viên giám đốc nói rất rõ: 'This particular party is important. People from the ministry are coming.' (Bữa tiệc cụ thể này rất quan trọng. Những người từ bộ sẽ đến). Vì vậy câu này mô tả hoàn toàn chính xác.

questions.content: The butler boiled caffeine in a kettle and chopped beef into chunks.
questions.explanation: Câu này là False (Sai) . Ở đoạn 5, người quản gia đun sôi NƯỚC chứ không phải đun sôi CAFFEINE: 'He boiled water in a kettle for soup and chopped some beef into chunks.' (Ông ấy đun sôi nước trong ấm để nấu súp và thái thịt bò thành từng cục). Đọc kỹ là nhận ra ngay điểm sai nhé!

questions.content: The soup for the gourmet dinner tasted too pungent.
questions.explanation: Câu này là True (Đúng) nhé. Trong đoạn 6 có chi tiết: '...and the soup tasted too pungent.' (...và món súp có vị quá hăng/cay nồng). Do đó câu hỏi đã nêu đúng tình tiết trong bài rồi.

questions.content: How was the butler while the superintendent slept soundly and snored?
options: While the superintendent slept soundly and snored, the butler was still awake.
The butler was out for a walk.
questions.explanation: Đáp án đúng là A nhé. Ở đoạn 2 có câu: '...while the superintendent slept soundly, snoring loudly in his bed, the butler was still awake.' (...trong khi viên giám đốc ngủ say sưa, ngáy to trên giường thì người quản gia vẫn còn thức). Do đó đáp án A là chính xác nhất!

questions.content: On his descent from the attic, what did the butler realize?
options: On his descent from the attic, he realized he needed to make the food.
He realized he lost his keys.
He realized someone was at the door.
He realized he forgot to clean the attic.
questions.explanation: Đáp án đúng là A . Đoạn 5 có miêu tả: 'But on his descent, he realized he needed to make the food.' (Nhưng trên đường đi xuống, ông nhận ra mình cần phải làm đồ ăn). Chọn A là chuẩn luôn!

questions.content: How could the butler have avoided the entire ordeal?
options: If he had told the superintendent earlier that he was tired, then he could have avoided the whole ordeal.
If he had quit his job.
If he had slept during the day.
If he had made the food earlier.
questions.explanation: Đáp án đúng là A nhé. Câu cuối cùng của bài viết trích lời của viên giám đốc: 'You should have told me earlier, then we could have avoided this whole ordeal.' (Ông nên nói với tôi sớm hơn, thì chúng ta đã có thể tránh được toàn bộ thử thách này). Rất khớp với đáp án A .

questions.content: Just as he started the soup, what did the butler remember?
options: As he started the soup, he remembered that he had to sweep the veranda.
He remembered he had to buy more beef.
He remembered to lock the door.
questions.explanation: Đáp án đúng là A . Đoạn 5 có câu kể rất rõ: 'Just as he was starting the soup, he remembered that he had to sweep the veranda.' (Ngay khi vừa bắt đầu nấu món súp, ông lại nhớ ra mình phải quét dọn hiên nhà). Vì thế đáp án A là câu trả lời đúng nhé.

questions.content: Why was the party filled with a din of unhappy guests making a fuss?
options: The party was filled with a din of unhappy guests making a fuss because some of the guests were dissatisfied.
Because the music was too loud.
Because the party started too late.
questions.explanation: Đáp án đúng là A . Ở đoạn 6 có giải thích nguyên nhân: 'Some guests were dissatisfied. They started to make a fuss...' (Một số vị khách cảm thấy không hài lòng. Họ bắt đầu làm ầm ĩ lên...). Sự không hài lòng (dissatisfied) của khách chính là nguyên nhân dẫn đến sự việc này.
